newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kansas City Southern FY97 up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kansas City Southern FY97 up.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Friday it increased its earnings estimate for Kansas City Southern Industries Inc in 1997 to $3.10 a share from $3.00 and raised its estimate for 1998 to $3.40 a share from $3.30.

-- The rail holding company beat nearly all analysts' estimates when it reported net income of $0.77 a share in the first quarter, Gruntal said. The big push to earnings came from financial asset management, which contributed about $0.69 to first-quarter results, Gruntal said.
-- Gruntal said it remains a risk-oriented buyer of Kansas City Southern shares, which continue to sell at a 33-percent discount from asset value under Gruntal's calculations.
-- Kansas City Southern stock was off 1/4 Friday at 51.
